report:
## Does Ivermectin Lower COVID-19 Mortality? No, Based on the Best Evidence

The current weight of high-quality evidence indicates ivermectin does **not** reduce COVID-19 mortality.

**Large randomized trials:** The most rigorous studies—ACTIV-6 (published in JAMA, 2022) and the TOGETHER trial (published in NEJM)—found no meaningful benefit. TOGETHER, a large placebo-controlled outpatient trial, showed only a modest, non-definitive difference in hospitalization (14.7% vs. 16.3%), and a follow-up NEJM correspondence noted the relative risk reduction did not meet the trial's pre-specified threshold for efficacy ([nejm.org](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMc2207995)). Wikipedia's summary confirms ACTIV-6 "found ivermectin was not effective as a COVID-19 treatment" ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ivermectin_during_the_COVID-19_pandemic)).

**Recent systematic reviews/meta-analyses:** A 2024 meta-analysis in *Heliyon*, covering 33 RCTs (n=10,489) through June 2023, concluded that ivermectin "did not have an effect in reducing the risk of mortality in patients with COVID-19" ([cell.com](https://www.cell.com/heliyon/fulltext/S2405-8440(24)03678-8)). Similarly, a 2022 systematic review in *BMC Infectious Diseases* reassessed evidence after accounting for retracted studies and found no consistent mortality benefit ([link.springer.com](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12879-022-07589-8)).

**Regulatory/expert consensus:** The WHO recommends ivermectin only within clinical trials, citing "very low certainty" evidence on mortality, ventilation, and hospitalization outcomes. The FDA has not approved it for COVID-19.

**Caveat:** Some earlier, smaller meta-analyses (e.g., a 2021 *EClinicalMedicine* study) reported reduced mortality, but these relied on lower-certainty evidence and were superseded by larger, more rigorous trials once fraudulent/retracted studies were excluded.

**Conclusion:** The most credible, updated randomized evidence supports "no"—ivermectin does not reduce COVID-19 mortality.
